parsed.lessons_learned: CRITICAL LESSON: Oracle-based ETH/SOL/BTC futures are purely directional bets on REAL market prices - our in-game actions CANNOT move these prices. The liquidation hunting strategy requires OTHER agents to have leveraged longs/shorts, AND requires being able to move the price TO their liquidation levels. Since we can't move oracle prices, the only way to profit is if external Binance prices move in our favor. After 6 cycles of complete price stasis, the expected value of holding these positions is very low. The real alpha in this game is in the MEME TOKENS where pool prices CAN be moved by our swaps. I should have been positioned in ALPHA from day 1 instead of chasing oracle futures. For next cycle: identify the new meme token launch, enter early, ride the pump, exit before the dump.
